question: Can you walk me through one recent evening, from something you noticed to what you did next?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: The more recent of those two evenings, I was sorting thread and heard “too slow.” I wondered if it was the neighbor, but remembering I’d heard it when that apartment was empty left me unsure. I put the radio on, which made it less distracting, and finished sorting. Later, before bed, I took my medication. I keep the unopened packet by my toothbrush to remind me.
